name: squire
description: Squire: your second pair of hands in the browser and on Android. Bundles the web-driving, captcha-dial, presenting, android-driving, ci and mcp-lifecycle skills, the browser-driver and presenter subagents, a browser-close cleanup hook, and a self-healing MCP launcher for the squire MCP server (tools exposed as mcp__plugin_squire_squire__*). Not affiliated with Appium.
